name: Fire Titan
primary:
A giant fire titan rises waist-deep from the ground at the aimed spot and fights from there while you keep the channel.
Ultimate channel: just stand still for up to 12 s. Stepping aside breaks the channel and the titan sinks back underground; instant mode does not apply. Needs open sky above the aimed spot.
It picks foes within 20 blocks and, about every 1.5 s, either hurls fireballs that explode within 2.5 blocks: damage 5 ❤ fire, heat 120;
or slams the ground with both fists, which sets the ground on fire; everyone within 5 blocks takes 4 ❤ fire and heat 150.
self_description:
On you:
• Heat 40
• Stone skin (resistance II), 15 s
